body:
A skipped master link refresh could still produce a valid distribution deck, but the operator summary claimed PowerPoint generation was skipped. The summary now uses the resolved per-output results, reports the generated distribution, and retains a yellow warning to verify the unrefreshed links/slides. Absent distributions remain explicitly reported; the aggregate manifest status stays compatible.

Closes #1065

## Tasks
- [x] Pass resolved per-output results into data-quality findings and distinguish link refresh from distribution generation.
- [x] Exercise actual distribution generation and the written manifest/operator summary, with explicit and inferred output metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `python -m pytest tests/pipeline/test_monthly_pipeline_ppt_outputs.py -q` — 14 passed, including `test_skipped_refresh_reports_existing_distribution` with successful-refresh controls and real decks reopened through python-pptx.
- [x] Skipped refresh retains WARN (YELLOW), acknowledges the generated distribution, and never emits PPT_GENERATION_SKIPPED for it. Both a disabled distribution and fully disabled PPT output remain explicitly reported.
- [x] Deliberately restored the original skipped-status branch in data_quality.py: the two skipped-refresh regression cases failed; the two successful-refresh controls passed. Restoring the fix passed all 33 focused tests.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest tests/pipeline/test_monthly_pipeline_ppt_outputs.py tests/pipeline/test_manifest_data_quality.py tests/pipeline/test_manifest_data_quality_entries.py -q` — 33 passed.
- Focused Ruff, Black, two production-module mypy checks, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Evidence: opener run `20260920T020158Z`, `ppt-tests.txt`, `deliberate-break.txt`, and `restored-tests.txt`.
- The repeatable CI marker below restores the original manifest wiring to prove the regression detects omitted per-output evidence; the direct data-quality branch restoration is recorded above.
